verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation ships GNOME Boxes, which per docs lets users select an OS and have the app handle VM creation without manual configuration, directly matching the story. However, evidence is limited to a single vendor marketing line with no independent/hands-on corroboration of ease-of-use, speed, or developer workflow specifics (e.g., CLI/automation, snapshotting, networking). missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Boxes VM creation experience, details on developer-specific workflows (scripting, cloud-init, snapshots), and comparison to manual libvirt/virt-manager setup.
